name: session-reaper
description: Frees the memory of idle Claude Code sessions (desktop app, VS Code, CLI) by stopping their process trees (desktop sessions stay in the sidebar), optionally archives desktop sessions, and stops idle process trees left behind by ended sessions

idleMinutes.title: Release after idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Stop the process tree of a session with no activity for this many minutes. A desktop session stays in the sidebar and restarts when opened; a VS Code or CLI session loses its claude.exe and keeps its transcript. Running sessions, sessions with a working side session, background task or scheduled wakeup are not released.

stuckMinutes.title: Release stuck running sessions after minutes (0 = never)
stuckMinutes.description: Release a desktop session the app still shows as running after this many minutes without activity.

archiveMinutes.title: Archive after idle minutes (0 = never)
archiveMinutes.description: Also archive a session with no activity for this many minutes. Running and pinned sessions are never archived.

orphanMinutes.title: Orphan minimum age (minutes)
orphanMinutes.description: Stop a left-behind process tree only when every process in it is at least this old.

cpuIdleMs.title: Idle CPU limit (ms per check)
cpuIdleMs.description: A left-behind process tree counts as idle when each process used at most this much CPU time since the previous check.

intervalMinutes.title: Check interval (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: How often the active session checks.
